title: Dr / GP

name: Northside Clinic
title: General practice
description: "At Northside Clinic we are experienced in supporting the health and wellbeing of the trans, gender diverse and non binary people." Most GPs prescribe hormones after a specialist mental health assessment; "Some Northside Clinic GPs start hormones for gender affirmation using the 'informed consent' model." Practice nurses offer hormone education including testosterone self-injection. Under-18s are usually referred to RCH. Individual prescribers are not named.
specialties: trans and gender diverse health, gender affirming hormones, sexual health, HIV, LGBTQIA health
